result.strongest_objection: The §3 inventory — the table offered as the answer to GLM r6(a), carrying §1.4's claim 'Those tests were run at this base (V35)' — does not hold at the base's own tool pin for 9 of the 16 cmd/ailang-worldd tests. V35 records a first run under the plan's retired v0.52.1 pin (9 PASS / 7 FAIL, every failure 'want release AILANG v0.54.15') and a re-run of only those 7 failures under v0.54.15 ('7/7 PASS'); §3's own annotations confirm the split — exactly M2b×2 + M4a×1 + M4b×2 + M5c×2 = 7 tests are marked '(v0.54.15)', while M2a's three tests, M3a's two, M3b's three and M6's TestServeWorkbenchStillFlag are unmarked, meaning their PASS was produced by the v0.52.1 binary even though V36 proves the workspace at base pins v0.54.15. Tests that consume tool-produced output (TestDemoSeedAuthenticatedCommits, TestDemoSeedHelpPreparation) can be version-sensitive — the suite's own M2b failures prove version sensitivity is real — so those nine 'results at base' were measured at a state that will not ship. That is precisely the defect GLM r6 rejected the parent for, reproduced inside the evidence presented as its cure, and §3's 'Not re-verified at base' list omits it.
result.catch: R1 (§5) has the controller rewrite png.go:27's provisional content thresholds, but no V-row checks whether the landed M7b pinning tests (TestMarketingPNGContent, TestMarketingTwoPassInventory) hard-code the provisional values — the exact coupling class V54 was run to detect for M7c0's shot heights; if they pin them, R1 reds the landed suite mid-sequence with no assigned disposition. result.strongest_objection: The acceptance section is internally falsified for one of the six shots, and the doc's own load-bearing lesson makes that fatal. V43 established the core premise of this revision: byte-identical + nonblank captures pass even when the image shows nothing required (1 sampled colour, 9,069 B, byte-identical across passes). The entire C8'/P0 position-assertion machinery exists because of that finding. Yet §4.4 P0 exempts phone from the position assertion ('Phone is the exception... This gap is disclosed and has not been closed') because V51 measured that the dump-dom instrument cannot lay out at 390 px (innerWidth 500), while C8' nonetheless asserts 'For all six shots... the P0 position assertion (±2 px of the R1 baseline, bottom ≤ H − 40) holds.' As written, C8' is unsatisfiable-by-design for phone — the acceptance criterion claims a property the document itself proves cannot be measured. The promised fallback ('measured in the screenshot itself,' R1) names no method, has no probe, and has no executed V-row demonstrating it produces stable pixel rectangles; the only phone evidence anywhere is V50, a single controller visual inspection of one pass-A PNG, on the shot that also carries a known rendering defect (horizontal overflow, title clipped to 'AILANG World Workbenc'). So the least-instrumented, known-defective shot is discharged on the weakest evidence while the headline acceptance criterion overclaims uniform coverage — the same genus of self-contradiction (claim vs. own annotation) that the r6 reviewers correctly rejected the parent for.
result.catch: Two specific things: (1) Reconcile C8' and C12 with the P0 phone exception — either strike 'all six' / 'every' from C8' and write the phone carve-out into the acceptance text (mirroring §4.4), or define a phone position check that is actually executable. (2) Before dispatching R1 as written, execute and log whatever 'measured in the screenshot itself' means for phone (e.g., a colour-boundary/feature scan on the V41 phone.png against a stored reference rectangle) as a new V-row; today that method is asserted, not demonstrated, and R1's phone step cannot otherwise be performed or judged.
result.proposed_fix: Rewrite C8' as: 'For the five 1440 px shots, every required region lies inside its image at the M7c0 geometry and the P0 position assertion (±2 px of the R1 baseline, bottom ≤ H − 40) holds. For phone, whose 390 px layout the dump-dom instrument cannot measure (V51), the check is: (i) phone header and first-timeline-entry rectangles extracted from the capture-day PNG by the V56 scan, matching the R1 phone baseline within ±4 px; (ii) the M7b content-variance gate inside those rectangles; (iii) the disclosed overflow defect unchanged versus the V50 reference image (title clip and horizontal-scrollbar geometry identical within ±2 px). C8' makes no claim that the P0 layout assertion applies to phone.' Make the matching edit to C12 ('P3 holds on the release store' retains the same phone carve-out). Add and execute V56: run the phone-rectangle extraction scan on both passes of the V41 phone.png and on a deliberately wrong crop (e.g., timeline-only), recording that identical rectangles are recovered on the two passes and that the wrong crop fails (i)/(ii); attach raw output. Then amend §5 R1's phone bullet to: 'phone: the header and the first timeline entry, extracted with the V56 scan from the R1 PNG (baseline stored with WORLD_MARKETING_RECTS), because the dump-dom instrument cannot open a 390 px window (V51).'
